source.source_title: Saint Paul Police Detectives and Their Work: A Color Chartoon
source.why_this_clip: A round candy on a flat wooden stick slides across a dark blue surface from the left edge to the right edge, the stick tilting as it goes. The clip has a hard cut at 4.75 s that the detector missed; this interval lies inside the second shot and is the longest stretch where the candy head is in frame, though it is half out of frame at both ends.
